episodes.title: Thousands of children in London boys schools denied basic education
episodes.description: Newsnight featured our exposé about the 1000 or so boys in North London who are being educated outside of the legal school system, and denied even a basic education in subjects like English and maths. Instead, they learn nothing but Torah from dawn to dusk in buildings which in some cases fail health and safety requirements. See more at http://www.offthederech.site

episodes.title: Meet Shulem Deen | Off The Derech - On Your Own Path
episodes.description:
The two most important things in the life of a Hasidic Jew are God and family, and in the Hasid world, when you lose one, you lose the other. Meet Shulem Deen who lost his home, his friends, his wife, and his children for being considered a 'Heretic' in his ultra orthodox Jewish community.What he gained however was freedom...Watch his story here.
Read more at: http://www.offthederech.site

episodes.title: Off The Derech by Etty - Off The Derech Site - OTD
episodes.description:
"My film is about my struggle, and others like me, who go off into our own path."

episodes.title: Leaving the ultra-Orthodox Jewish community in Jerusalem - Documentary, Off The Derech, GOTDS
episodes.description: Leaving the ultra-Orthodox Jewish community in Jerusalem: 613 prohibitions and regulations for the daily life are too much Haim. At 21, he takes off his long black coat. http://www.offthederech.site
